result.summary: Several layout and truncation issues: restaurant names and category chips are cut off, and content is clipped at the edges of horizontal carousels.

issues.description: The third restaurant card title in 'Fastest near you' is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' instead of the full name.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or ensure the card width accommodates the full restaurant name without clipping.

issues.description: Category filter chips (e.g. after 'Healthy') are cut off at the right edge with no clear affordance that the row scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scroll with partial next-chip visibility or a fade/arrow indicator so users know more filters exist.

issues.description: The rightmost card in the 'Fastest near you' row is heavily cropped, making the carousel feel unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Show a larger portion of the next card or add consistent padding/peek so horizontal scrolling is obvious.

issues.description: The pizza promotion card at the bottom is cut off mid-image with no visible restaurant name or details in the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Ensure cards have enough vertical space or that scrolling reveals full card content including title and metadata.
